description: Fork of exp156 (annealing 10x, val_bpb=1.7108). Replace soft attention with hard-forward / soft-backward STE: forward uses A_hard = one-hot(argmax(s)), backward uses A_soft = softmax(s * attn_scale / sqrt(P)) as gradient surrogate. A = A_soft + (A_hard - A_soft).detach(). No annealing ramp. learnable_attn_scale only controls backward sharpness. Hypothesis: hard attention is LUT-friendly (output of A@V is a single concrete V row, valid as a ranking) and should land within bf16 noise of exp154/156 (1.7105/1.7108). Bypasses BitAttention kernel: explicit attention via float matmul on q,k (which are already ±1 dominance vectors).
